noteGrp.note: Originally written in Koine Greek, Cyril of Alexandria’s Commentary on Luke survives in Syriac translation, with only quoted fragments of Greek. This collection of 156 homilies, composed during the burgeoning Nestorian controversy, was discovered in the Nitrian Desert in Egypt in 1842 and later published in English translation in 1859.
